sourceTrace: Shared image draw uses fitSkull175/(chinY-crownY). Front body nested head scales skullHeight/175; side builder uses height/175. Motion uses the same skeletal skullHeight formula. Therefore the net mesh-to-inch scale is skullHeight/(chinY-crownY), matching the observer. Camera translation and rotation do not change scalar volume.
The diagnostic integrates only actual skin triangles. Hair, beard, lids and open ear surfaces are excluded rather than incorrectly added as independent closed tissue solids.

Skull height is9.4+(stature-74)*.035. At fixed saved appearance/stature it does not depend on mass. The fixed12.5% artistic reserve scales with mass; the four controlled values therefore expose a real mismatch between an allocation and independently reconstructed head geometry.

Reserved hand/foot lengths do not define their depth or sealed volume. Root caps, overlaps and head/neck union remain unreconciled. The unexplained reserve is a bookkeeping residual, not measured missing tissue.
qualifications: The oriented-area residual supports consistency and translation invariance but does not alone prove manifold watertightness, non-self-intersection or correct biological anatomy.
The last refinement delta is a successive-mesh change, not a certified bound on true continuum volume error.
Nine examples are selected actual generated positions, not a fitted league or population distribution.
Observer records primary RNG seed-state invariance; the independent probe additionally checks all league players. This is not full command-outcome or all-feature invariance.
No PNG or visual naturalism inspection was needed or claimed for this numerical diagnostic.
